'''East Atadei''', also known as '''South Lembata''' from its location, is a [[Central Malayo-Polynesian languages|Central Malayo-Polynesian]] language of [[Indonesia]] spoken in the Atadei District of [[Lembata]], an island east of [[Flores]].<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Krauße|first1=Daniel|title=A Brief Grammar of the Eastern Atadei Language of Lembata, Indonesia|journal=Linguistik Indonesia|date=2016|volume=34|issue=2|pages=115–116|url=http://www.linguistik-indonesia.org/images/files/ABriefGrammaroftheEasternAtadei.pdf|access-date=9 August 2017|archive-date=15 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210415055613/http://www.linguistik-indonesia.org/images/files/ABriefGrammaroftheEasternAtadei.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
